S.FORM: alang Ruba' ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Gpho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 77 buwan, 220 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 97% kyan ku 213 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 3% kyan ku 7 hi nya. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Ruba' hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Ruba' hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Ruba' hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Ruba' hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Ruba' hya' ga Kukung. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ruβaʔ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu ɣpħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na ruβaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na ruβaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na ruβaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ruβaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na ruβaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa kukuŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
